subject: general
question: In a row of 74 girls, Shweta is 27th from left end. Palak is 7th to the right of Shweta. What is Palak's position from the right end of the row?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c41c7d0463648f6b53d9c78817d031f3305c2b156a110a992f8dbaf5e5f27edb.png] 

Palak's position from the right end of the row = Total no. of students – Palak’s position from the left end + 1

= 74 – 34 + 1

= 41.

Hence, 41 is the correct ans.
